subject.title: chore: finish Agent Skill ecosystem publication after 0.39.1

question: After the shared Skill ships, should Crabbox keep distribution limited to the standard Skill managers and external registry listing, or sponsor a header-capable edge and/or host-specific marketplace manifests?
rationale: The checklist explicitly raises optional distribution paths whose ongoing ownership, hosting behavior, and value beyond the shared Skill cannot be selected from source evidence alone.

options.title: Ship the shared Skill first
options.body: Complete only the release-gated publication checks and retain one shared Skill implementation unless real registry demand demonstrates a missing route.

options.title: Sponsor an edge-hosting follow-up
options.body: Approve a separate design and implementation for strict AI Catalog media types if compatibility evidence shows GitHub Pages MIME types block relevant consumers.

options.title: Sponsor a host marketplace package
options.body: Approve a separate vendor-specific manifest only when that marketplace adds material distribution beyond the standard Skill installers.

recommendation.title: Ship the shared Skill first
recommendation.body: Complete only the release-gated publication checks and retain one shared Skill implementation unless real registry demand demonstrates a missing route.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked implementation and checklist, making them the best available routing contact; final product direction still needs a repository decision-maker.
